# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀掃描 mailbox node，輸出一行 JSON，彙總有效信件、未解決的 REQUEST 與壞檔；不修復資料。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo /path/to/node --now 2026-10-10T00:00:00+08:00
```

`--now` 必須是帶時區的 ISO 時間；資料中無時區的 `at` 使用它的時區。目錄不存在或參數無效時退出碼為 2，stdout 為空。

測試與獨立核對：

```sh
python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests
python3 check_answer.py proto7-2 fixture
```

"""End-to-end checks for the read-only mailbox CLI."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-10T00:01:00+08:00"


def letter(folder, filename, ident, status="REQUEST", at="2026-10-09T23:01:00+08:00",
           sender="alice", recipient="bob", reply=None):
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = ["---", "id: " + ident, "from: " + sender, "to: " + recipient,
             "status: " + status, "at: " + at]
    if reply is not None:
        lines.append("re: " + reply)
    (folder / filename).write_text("\n".join(lines + ["---", "body", ""]), encoding="utf-8")


def run_cli(folder, *args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(folder), *args],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)


def snapshot(folder):
    result = {}
    for path in [folder, *folder.rglob("*")]:
        info = path.lstat()
        result[path.relative_to(folder).as_posix()] = (
            stat.S_IFMT(info.st_mode), info.st_size, stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode),
            info.st_mtime_ns, path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() else None)
    return result


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rollup_and_unchanged_fixture(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            alice = root / "alice" / "inbox"
            bob = root / "bob" / "inbox"
            (root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            letter(alice, "20261009T2301-a.md", "a")
            letter(alice, "20261010T0002-b.md", "b", at="2026-10-10T00:02:00", recipient="zed")
            letter(bob, "20261009T2301-c.md", "c")
            letter(bob / "done", "20261009T2302-answer.md", "answer", "DONE", reply="c")
            letter(alice, "20261009T2303-progress.md", "progress", "PROGRESS", reply="a")
            letter(bob / "done", "20261009T2304-d.md", "d", recipient="amy")
            old_mode = stat.S_IMODE(alice.stat().st_mode)
            alice.chmod(0o555)
            before = snapshot(root)
            try:
                result = run_cli(root, "--now", NOW)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
                self.assertTrue(result.stdout.endswith("\n"))
                self.assertEqual(snapshot(root), before)
            finally:
                alice.chmod(old_mode)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(set(data), {"v", "open", "boxes", "bad"})
            self.assertIs(type(data["v"]), int)
            self.assertEqual(data["v"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [])
            self.assertEqual(data["open"], [
                {"id": "d", "from": "alice", "to": "amy", "where": "done", "age_min": 60},
                {"id": "a", "from": "alice", "to": "bob", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 60},
                {"id": "b", "from": "alice", "to": "zed", "where": "inbox", "age_min": -1}])
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {
                "alice": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 2, "PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 0},
                "bob": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 2},
                "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}})

    def test_bad_precedence_duplicates_and_ignored_files(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            inbox = root / "box" / "inbox"
            letter(inbox, "20261010T0000-first.md", "same")
            letter(inbox / "done", "20261010T0001-copy.md", "same")
            letter(inbox, "invalid.md", "other", at="not-a-date")
            letter(inbox, "invalid2.md", "other2")
            letter(inbox, "20261310T0000-date.md", "date")
            (inbox / "20261010T0000-missing.md").write_text("---\nid: missing\n---\n")
            (inbox / "20261010T0000-plain.md").write_text("not frontmatter\n")
            (inbox / ".hidden.md").write_text("not frontmatter\n")
            (inbox / "nested").mkdir()
            (inbox / "nested" / "20261010T0000-nested.md").write_text("bad\n")
            (root / ".hidden" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            os.symlink(inbox / "20261010T0000-plain.md", inbox / "20261010T0000-link.md")
            result = run_cli(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261010T0000-missing.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261010T0000-plain.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/20261310T0000-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/done/20261010T0001-copy.md", "why": "dup_id"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/invalid.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": "box/inbox/invalid2.md", "why": "bad_name"}])
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {"box": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 0}})
            self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in data["open"]], ["same"])

    def test_last_key_wins_and_invalid_reply_does_not_resolve(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            inbox = root / "box" / "inbox"
            letter(inbox, "20261010T0000-request.md", "work", at="2026-10-10T00:00:00")
            letter(inbox / "done", "20261010T0000-empty.md", "empty", "DONE", reply="work")
            empty = inbox / "done" / "20261010T0000-empty.md"
            empty.write_text(empty.read_text().replace("re: work\n", "re: work\nre: \n"))
            letter(inbox / "done", "20261010T0000-invalid.md", "invalid", "DONE", reply="work")
            invalid = inbox / "done" / "20261010T0000-invalid.md"
            invalid.write_text(invalid.read_text().replace("re: work\n", "re: work\nat: invalid\n"))
            result = run_cli(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(data["open"], [
                {"id": "work", "from": "alice", "to": "bob", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 1}])
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {"box": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 1}})
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [
                {"file": "box/inbox/done/20261010T0000-invalid.md", "why": "no_field"}])

    def test_unicode_line_separators_remain_in_values(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            inbox = root / "box" / "inbox"
            letter(inbox, "20261010T0000-unicode.md", "task\u2028ref",
                   at="2026-10-10\u202800:00:00+08:00",
                   sender="ali\u2028ce", recipient="bob\u000bteam")
            result = run_cli(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(data["bad"], [])
            self.assertEqual(data["boxes"], {"box": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 0}})
            self.assertEqual(data["open"], [
                {"id": "task\u2028ref", "from": "ali\u2028ce", "to": "bob\u000bteam",
                 "where": "inbox", "age_min": 1}])

    def test_invalid_arguments_leave_stdout_empty(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            regular = root / "file"
            regular.write_text("file")
            for folder, args in ((root / "absent", ("--now", NOW)),
                                 (regular, ("--now", NOW)), (root, ()),
                                 (root, ("--now", "bad")),
                                 (root, ("--now", "2026-10-10T00:01:00"))):
                with self.subTest(folder=folder, args=args):
                    result = run_cli(folder, *args)
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                    self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
